This page loads head.js, minimalist.min.css, and an optional ambient module. Switch voice and type in the bar below; both persist.

What the voice changes

  • Bullets and prompts: * and > for nerd, a dash for neutral, a dot for professional.
  • Strokes: dashed for nerd, solid frame for neutral, all solid for professional.
  • Type: mono everywhere for nerd, sans body for neutral, sans body and headings for professional.
